roles.name: Backend Developer
roles.description: Designs, develops, and maintains server-side logic, RESTful APIs, microservices, and database persistence architectures.

capabilities.name: API Development
capabilities.description: Ability to design, implement, and document deterministic RESTful HTTP API endpoints with proper routing, status codes, and input validation.
capabilities.evidenceRequirement: Working HTTP handlers with automated integration test coverage and status code verification.

capabilities.name: Backend Debugging & Error Handling
capabilities.description: Ability to diagnose runtime errors, race conditions, edge-case arithmetic defects, and structure centralized error responses.
capabilities.evidenceRequirement: Diagnosis of root cause in existing code and verified bug fix submission.

capabilities.name: Automated Testing & Regression
capabilities.description: Ability to author comprehensive unit tests, mock external dependencies, and assert boundary conditions and regressions.
capabilities.evidenceRequirement: Candidate-authored test suite achieving 100% pass rate on edge cases.

capabilities.name: Database Fundamentals & Schema Design
capabilities.description: Understanding relational and document data modeling, indexing, query optimization, and data integrity constraints.
capabilities.evidenceRequirement: Schema definitions, query pipelines, and transaction integrity checks.

capabilities.name: Authentication & Security Basics
capabilities.description: Implementation of secure password hashing, JWT stateless authentication, authorization middlewares, and input sanitization.
capabilities.evidenceRequirement: Token verification middleware and role-based access control tests.

capabilities.name: Git & Version Control
capabilities.description: Proficiency with atomic commits, branch workflows, diff inspection, and clean pull request descriptions.
capabilities.evidenceRequirement: Clean commit history and structured technical submission explanation.

roles.name: Frontend Developer
roles.description: Builds responsive, accessible, interactive web user interfaces using modern component frameworks and state management.

capabilities.name: Component Architecture
capabilities.description: Structuring modular, reusable, typed UI components with clean prop contracts and lifecycle separation.
capabilities.evidenceRequirement: Clean component tree with typed props and zero compilation warnings.

capabilities.name: Client State Management
capabilities.description: Managing complex asynchronous data fetching, local component state, cache synchronization, and optimistic UI updates.
capabilities.evidenceRequirement: Predictable state transitions verified by interactive DOM test assertions.

capabilities.name: Responsive Layout & Accessibility (a11y)
capabilities.description: Crafting fluid layouts across mobile/desktop viewports and adhering to WCAG standards (keyboard navigation, ARIA semantics).
capabilities.evidenceRequirement: Responsive layout without horizontal overflow and screen-reader accessible elements.

capabilities.name: REST/API Client Integration
capabilities.description: Handling HTTP fetch lifecycles, graceful loading skeletons, network retry logic, and validation error displays.
capabilities.evidenceRequirement: Async network state handling covering loading, success, and error boundaries.

capabilities.name: UI Component Testing
capabilities.description: Writing automated unit and integration tests for user interactions, forms, and render outputs.
capabilities.evidenceRequirement: Passing user-event test suite simulating clicks, typing, and state assertions.

roles.name: Full Stack Developer
roles.description: Delivers end-to-end features spanning responsive frontend interfaces, REST APIs, database models, and deployment configurations.

capabilities.name: API Development
capabilities.description: Design and implementation of deterministic REST APIs with validation and error handling.
capabilities.evidenceRequirement: End-to-end API route execution with passing test assertions.

capabilities.name: Component Architecture
capabilities.description: Reusable UI components integrated with backend REST responses.
capabilities.evidenceRequirement: Interactive frontend components connected to API endpoints.

capabilities.name: Database Fundamentals
capabilities.description: Data modeling and query persistence in relational or NoSQL datastores.
capabilities.evidenceRequirement: Database CRUD operations with schema validation.

capabilities.name: Full-Stack Debugging
capabilities.description: Tracing defects across network boundaries, client state, and backend controllers.
capabilities.evidenceRequirement: Verified resolution of cross-boundary bugs.

capabilities.name: Automated Testing
capabilities.description: Writing tests across both API layers and UI components.
capabilities.evidenceRequirement: Combined test pass rate on automated evaluation suite.

roles.name: Data Analyst
roles.description: Extracts, transforms, and analyzes structured datasets to identify trends, formulate insights, and build visualization dashboards.

capabilities.name: SQL & Complex Aggregations
capabilities.description: Writing multi-table joins, subqueries, window functions, and group-by aggregations for business reporting.
capabilities.evidenceRequirement: Accurate SQL query results against analytical datasets.

capabilities.name: Data Cleaning & Transformation
capabilities.description: Handling missing values, deduplication, date parsing, and type conversions in tabular datasets.
capabilities.evidenceRequirement: Automated dataset sanitization pipeline with validation metrics.

capabilities.name: Data Visualization & Metrics
capabilities.description: Designing clear visual dashboards, charting metrics, and summarizing distributions.
capabilities.evidenceRequirement: Statistical chart outputs and explanatory insight reports.

roles.name: AI/ML Engineer
roles.description: Builds, evaluates, and deploys machine learning models, data preprocessing pipelines, and generative AI integrations.

capabilities.name: ML Modeling & Preprocessing
capabilities.description: Feature engineering, dataset splitting, supervised/unsupervised algorithm implementation, and evaluation metric calculation.
capabilities.evidenceRequirement: Model training pipeline with verified precision, recall, and loss evaluation.

capabilities.name: LLM & Generative AI Integration
capabilities.description: Designing structured prompting workflows, JSON schema validation, embedding search, and API orchestration.
capabilities.evidenceRequirement: Deterministic schema-validated generative AI pipelines with fallback handling.

capabilities.name: Model Evaluation & Benchmarking
capabilities.description: Benchmarking models against ground truth datasets and preventing hallucinations.
capabilities.evidenceRequirement: Benchmark test suite assertions and accuracy reporting.
